headline: Businessman shot and injured in Dhaka shop, suspect detained
summary: A 38-year-old crockery business owner was shot in his shop at Shani Akhra on Saturday night; the attacker was caught by locals.
details: A 38-year-old businessman, Aslam Khan, was shot and injured inside his business premises in the Shani Akhra area of Dhaka on Saturday night.
The incident occurred around 8:00 PM on Saturday, September 5, at a crockery shop on Shani Akhra Zia Smriti Road in Jatrabari.
According to the victim's cousin, Miraj Khan, Aslam was speaking with a customer in his shop when a man entered and shot him.
Aslam Khan sustained gunshot wounds to his left hand and right cheek. He was immediately rushed to a local hospital and later transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital.
Local residents caught the attacker as he attempted to flee the scene and handed him over to the police.
The identity of the suspect has not yet been disclosed, and the motive behind the shooting remains unknown.

headline_marked: BDT 25 Crore Gold Seized: [[Biman employee's belt hidden gold recovered]] at HSIA
headline: BDT 25 Crore Gold Seized: Biman employee's belt hidden gold recovered at HSIA
summary: Customs officials recovered 120 gold bars weighing 13.92 kg from an Assistant Technical Helper of Biman Bangladesh Airlines.
details: A joint team of Dhaka Custom House and intelligence agencies recovered 13.92 kg of gold from a Biman Bangladesh Airlines employee at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport (HSIA).
The seized gold, consisting of 120 gold bars, has an estimated market value of BDT 25 crore.
The operation took place on Saturday around 11:00 AM following a tip-off regarding gold smuggling on flight BG-148, which arrived from the Dubai-Chattogram-Dhaka route.
The gold bars were found hidden inside the belt of Assistant Technical Helper Md. Soeb Gazi, wrapped in black scotch tape, as he was leaving the aircraft after cleaning duties.
Customs officials suspect the employee was smuggling the gold into the country to evade taxes and duties, intending to move it outside the airport perimeter.
The seized gold bars have been deposited in the airport customs warehouse and are being processed for deposit into the Bangladesh Bank.
